WITH
  cc_joins AS (
    SELECT
      cc.movie_id,
      ci.person_id,
      ci.person_role_id,
      t.id AS title_id,
      t.kind_id,
      t.production_year,
      mi_idx.info_type_id,
      mi_idx.info,
      mk.keyword_id,
      k.keyword,
      cct1.id AS cast_subject_id,
      cct2.id AS cast_status_id
    FROM complete_cast AS cc
    JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct1 ON cct1.kind = 'cast'
    JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct2 ON cct2.kind LIKE '%complete%'
    JOIN cast_info AS ci ON cc.movie_id = ci.movie_id AND ci.person_role_id = chn.id
    JOIN title AS t ON t.id = cc.movie_id
    JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON t.id = mi_idx.movie_id AND mi_idx.info_type_id = it2.id
    JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON t.id = mk.movie_id AND mk.keyword_id = k.id
    JOIN info_type AS it2 ON it2.info = 'rating'
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.keyword IN ('superhero', 'marvel-comics', 'based-on-comic', 'tv-special', 'fight', 'violence', 'magnet', 'web', 'claw', 'laser')
  ),
  chn_name AS (
    SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS character_name
    FROM char_name AS chn
    WHERE chn.name IS NOT NULL AND (chn.name LIKE '%man%' OR chn.name LIKE '%Man%')
  ),
  kt AS (
    SELECT t.kind_id AS kind_id, t.id AS title_id FROM title AS t JOIN kind_type ON t.kind_id = kt.id WHERE kt.kind = 'movie'
  )
SELECT
  character_name,
  rating,
  title_id AS complete_hero_movie
FROM cc_joins
JOIN chn_name ON TRUE
JOIN kt ON cc_joins.title_id = kt.title_id
WHERE t.production_year > 2000 AND kt.kind = 'movie'
